snippet_primary: "Webhooks allow you to set up integrations which subscribe to certain events from your Payhip store. There are 4 webhook events available for you to listen from." Events: paid, refunded, subscription.created, subscription.deleted. "If your endpoint does not return a 200 HTTP status code, the POST is retried once an hour for up to 3 hours."
subject_exact: Payhip help documentation describes webhook system: 4 event types (paid, refunded, subscription.created, subscription.deleted); failed webhook delivery retried once per hour for up to 3 hours if endpoint does not return HTTP 200
